metadata.notes: T-113 candidate (unpublished, evaluation only): closed upper lids follow the eyeball (eyes.lids.closed_fit, face_v3/lids.py fit_closed_lids; no pale dome in Blink/Smile/Laugh/Squint); optional presets listed so the per-character emotions play: Pout (T-109) for boy_reluctant. Belongs in assets/characters/boy_yellow_hoodie/spec/candidates/T-113/ (outside the T-113 write-set). closed_fit.shell_subsurface 0: the upper lid shell (1-2 mm) gets a skin copy without subsurface; with the skin's 1.4 cm subsurface radius the closed lid otherwise shows the white eyeball through it (the pale part of the dome).
